goal: Confirm the frozen Optional absence and no-value-fallback product contract without changing adjacent pattern, numeric, directional-flow/settlement, or ABI policy.
description: Scope: Requirements.md and the O01-Q01/O01-Q06..Q07/P01.13-B decision trace. Context: ordinary T excludes absence, ? | T is canonical, repeated Optional normalizes, and the owner rejected the entire ordinary value fallback surface. Target: keep REQ-OA-001..REQ-OA-008 complete, source-observable, and bounded away from convenience APIs, D08 numeric failure behavior, P01.14-A directional-flow/settlement implementation, and foreign layout. Design Considerations: distinguish semantic absence, compiler unknown type, typed effect failure, Unit, and physical inactive payload bytes. Design Value: prevents implementation convenience from recreating a sentinel or replacement operator. Constraints & Risks: if later evidence changes a source-visible rule, update requirements and validation before implementation rather than widening this node.

acceptance_criteria.text: Requirements.md states users, functional requirements, non-functional constraints, scope, non-goals, and final acceptance for REQ-OA-001..REQ-OA-008.
Every requirement traces to a frozen owner decision or an explicitly internal representation consequence without reopening D02.
The D08 numeric, P01.14-A directional-flow/settlement, pattern/convenience, and foreign-ABI boundaries are explicit.

goal: Verify the Optional type gap, every retired value-fallback route, every sentinel-as-absence consumer, and every anchored pipe boundary before source work.
description: Scope: Evidence.md plus read-only inspection of StyioToken, Parser, AST, TypeTable, Sema, IR, lowering, codegen, resource topology, IDE syntax, tests, and active docs. Context: the repository mixes an orphan ?? token, bare-pipe FallbackAST/SGFallback, UndefinedLitAST/SGUndef, and i64::MIN while current resource fallback remains valid. Target: cite exact symbols, classify each Fallback occurrence by semantic owner, separate Optional sentinel use from D08 numeric use, and record primary language failure lessons. Design Considerations: repository facts and external lessons inform the frozen target but cannot invent a replacement operator. Design Value: prevents both incomplete deletion and collateral removal of effect settlement. Constraints & Risks: classification must be semantic, not a case-insensitive text deletion by the word fallback.

acceptance_criteria.text: Evidence.md cites tokenizer, parser, AST, Sema, TypeTable, IR, lowering, codegen, topology, tooling, and test paths.
Every fallback-named implementation/test family is classified as removed value fallback, preserved effect settlement, or unrelated host infrastructure.
Sentinel evidence separates Optional absence from D08-owned numeric behavior and includes i64::MIN payload risk.
Primary other-language sources document coalescing, truthiness, nesting, and representation failure modes.

goal: Define Optional value-domain, normalization, syntax rejection, anchored-pipe preservation, structural deletion, and convergence evidence before implementation.
description: Scope: Validation.md and test/gate discovery only. Context: a blanket pipe rejection would break type, guard, and settlement syntax, while parser-only success could leave fallback IR or a sentinel behind. Target: map every REQ-OA label to positive Optional cases, payload extremes, negative |/?? cases, anchored-pipe regressions, TypeId/layout checks, structural searches, and end-to-end gates. Design Considerations: pair every removed form with its nearest preserved grammar role and require evidence below the parser. Design Value: makes semantic deletion and non-regression measurable before code changes. Constraints & Risks: commands must name existing test families or specify exact tests to add; prose review alone is insufficient.

acceptance_criteria.text: Validation.md maps every REQ-OA label to executable or static evidence.
The matrix covers empty/present values, all three literals, normalization, payload extremes, functions/containers, and underdetermined empty inference.
Negative value operators are paired with positive type-union, guard-else, and effect-settlement cases.
Deletion searches, D08 routing, docs/tooling gates, and Better Plan validation are included in final acceptance.

goal: Freeze the structural Optional type, syntax-selected pipe roles, focused AST/IR modules, explicit native tag layout, ownership, and deletion architecture.
description: Scope: Architecture.md and interface/scaffold decisions; no compiler behavior is claimed complete. Context: StyioDataType/TypeTable are flat, empty and unknown nodes overlap, and codegen uses a legal i64 sentinel. Target: define TypeId normalization, one empty AST, expected-type present injection, typed OptionalNone/OptionalSome IR, verifier rules, direct LLVM tag/payload layout, guarded ownership/drop, cached layouts, diagnostics, and one-shot deletion. Design Considerations: use structural interning and a discriminated value because they eliminate repeated string/type checks and preserve full payload domains; keep simple syntax-directed parsing and add no runtime registry. Design Value: one cross-layer invariant replaces fallback/sentinel guessing. Constraints & Risks: do not choose D08 numeric failure policy, alter P01.14-A direction/settlement composition, choose pattern syntax or foreign layout, or add speculative niche optimization.

acceptance_criteria.text: Architecture.md defines module ownership, dependency direction, type/AST/Sema/IR/codegen interfaces, ownership, diagnostics, migration, and complexity.
The initial representation uses an explicit discriminant, specializes Unit without erasing presence, and preserves every legal payload bit pattern.
The deletion boundary preserves TOK_PIPE/AWAIT_PIPE and resource settlement while removing the complete value-fallback path.
Chosen patterns explain their value and no unnecessary managed runtime, registry, heap box, or niche mechanism is introduced.

goal: Converge tokenizer, grammar, and AST on structural Optional syntax while deleting every ordinary fallback/coalescing source path.
description: Scope: StyioToken, StyioParser, Optional-focused StyioAST files, parser/token/AST tests, IDE token syntax, and stable diagnostics. Context: Parser.cpp still calls parse_fallback_expr, Token.hpp maps | to Bitwise_OR, DBQUESTION is maximal-munch tokenized, and None/Undefined/Fallback nodes overlap. Target: parse ? | T and all three empty atoms, keep guard and leading ?| separators, reject general |/??, delete DBQUESTION and parse_fallback_expr/FallbackAST plus frontend visitors/clones/repr/topology hooks, and introduce one empty Optional AST. Design Considerations: grammar state selects each legal pipe; replace call sites with the correct non-pipe expression entry and split Optional AST responsibility from the mixed monolith where practical. Design Value: makes invalid value fallback impossible before Sema. Constraints & Risks: preserve TOK_PIPE/AWAIT_PIPE, resource-effect fallback AST members/tests, guard syntax, source spans, and parser recovery; do not activate bitwise punctuation or convenience Optional syntax.

acceptance_criteria.text: ? | T and the three empty atoms parse to the canonical Optional frontend nodes.
Bare/chained/Boolean/integer | and all ?? inputs fail with syntax-owned diagnostics before Sema.
Type-union, guard-else, and leading ?| settlement parser tests remain positive.
DBQUESTION, parse_fallback_expr, FallbackAST, value-pipe operator mapping, frontend visitors/clones/repr/topology routes, and positive node tests are absent.

goal: Implement canonical Optional TypeIds, normalization, empty/present typing, joins, and settlement-boundary separation in Sema.
description: Scope: StyioSession TypeTable, StyioDataType integration boundaries, Optional-focused StyioSema code, type/semantic tests, and IR-facing typed conversion facts. Context: TypeKey has no structural Optional payload and Undefined currently serves both unknown-state and source-value paths. Target: intern Optional(payload TypeId), flatten Optional-of-Optional once, keep compiler unknown distinct, type empty literals from expected/join context, record present injection explicitly, reject ordinary-T absence, and preserve resource settlement recovery compatibility under its own AST. Design Considerations: centralize make_optional/inject_present/join_empty operations for O(1) TypeId equality instead of scattering name-string checks. Design Value: gives all later layers one proof of presence and eliminates sentinel/type guessing. Constraints & Risks: no general subtyping, word constructors, unwrap/coalesce, hidden default, numeric error policy, or change to effect settlement semantics.

acceptance_criteria.text: TypeTable gives ? | (? | T) and ? | T one canonical TypeId with O(1) equality.
Empty, present injection, assignment, argument, return, field/element, and branch-join tests enforce the static absence boundary.
Underdetermined empty and empty-under-ordinary-T cases fail without an invented payload type or default.
Compiler unknown type state is not a source value, and resource settlement fallback typing stays on its dedicated path.

goal: Lower verified Optional values through one typed IR and explicit native discriminant while deleting undefined/fallback IR and absence sentinels.
description: Scope: Optional-focused StyioIR, verifier/walker, StyioLowering, StyioCodeGen, ToString, ownership/drop logic, tests, and the numeric-sentinel classification record. Context: SGUndef emits i64::MIN and SGFallback eagerly lowers both operands; neither represents the frozen type model. Target: add typed OptionalNone/OptionalSome nodes, verify TypeIds/payloads, emit cached {present,payload} layouts and tag-only Optional Unit, guard every payload use/drop, delete SGUndef/SGFallback and their complete visitor/type/codegen/test routes, and prove Some(i64::MIN) remains present. Design Considerations: explicit tags avoid legal-value collisions; deterministic inactive storage plus verifier-dominated projection avoids poison and false payload construction; no managed runtime helper. Design Value: preserves full value domains with predictable native cost. Constraints & Risks: classify remaining arithmetic sentinel uses for D08 instead of choosing trap/effect/saturation; do not expose an ABI or niche promise.

acceptance_criteria.text: OptionalNone/OptionalSome verifier, lowering, codegen, copy/drop, Unit specialization, and malformed-IR tests pass.
Empty/present round trips cover payload extrema and Some(i64::MIN) is never classified empty.
SGUndef, SGFallback, sentinel-as-absence comparisons, visitors, optimizer/type/repr routes, and positive node tests are absent.
Remaining numeric-only sentinel consumers are exhaustively recorded under D08 and cannot influence Optional presence.

goal: Converge fixtures, effect-settlement regressions, tooling mirrors, runbooks, and active language documents on the delivered Optional boundary.
description: Scope: source fixtures, tokenizer/parser/Sema/IR/codegen/security/resource-effect tests, IDE/editor/formatter mirrors, Language Design, EBNF, Symbol Reference, ACTIVE-SYNTAX, decision report, runbooks, generated indexes, and plan mappings. Context: old positive node tests can preserve removed value fallback, while broad fallback searches can wrongly delete current ?| recovery tests. Target: remove or migrate retired-node fixtures, keep rejected spellings only as current negative diagnostics, retain and if needed rename/classify anchored effect tests, publish implementation status honestly, and regenerate deterministic artifacts. Design Considerations: SSOT owns semantics and tests follow grammar/AST ownership, not historical labels. Design Value: prevents either compatibility debt or accidental effect-feature loss. Constraints & Risks: do not reopen D02, alter P01.14-A directional-flow/settlement composition, or claim D08 numeric closure.

acceptance_criteria.text: All active SSOT, syntax/tooling mirrors, and runbooks state the same Optional and no-value-fallback contract with current implementation status.
No positive fixture constructs a removed token/AST/IR/sentinel path; rejected forms remain only as registered negative syntax cases.
All type-union, guard, resource-effect, and task-settlement fallback tests remain current positive evidence.
Syntax convergence, generated indexes, docs audit/lifecycle, local-information, and plan validators pass.

goal: Prove the complete Optional absence boundary, value-fallback deletion, and anchored-settlement preservation on one head commit.
description: Scope: execute and record every Validation.md mapping; source fixes route back to their owning implementation node. Context: parser, TypeTable, Sema, IR, codegen, resource effects, tooling, and docs can each pass while a sentinel, orphan visitor, or over-broad pipe deletion survives elsewhere. Target: run all standing and REQ-specific checks, classify every residual fallback/sentinel match, record evidence per REQ-OA label, prove i64::MIN presence and Optional normalization, and synchronize Better Plan state. Design Considerations: validate source behavior, canonical types, ownership, native layout, diagnostics, deletion, anchored grammar, and documentation together. Design Value: turns the owner decisions into one auditable compiler contract. Constraints & Risks: acceptance cannot be weakened to retain compatibility, hide absence in T, delete current effect settlement, or silently choose D08 behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tokenizer, parser, type-table, Sema, IR verifier, lowering, codegen, ownership, resource-effect, task, security, syntax, docs, lifecycle, local-information, and Better Plan checks pass on one head commit.
Every REQ-OA label has recorded positive, negative, structural, payload-boundary, and anchored-role evidence from Validation.md.
No value-fallback/??/undefined-as-absence implementation or positive compatibility fixture remains, and Some(i64::MIN) plus ? | unit behavior are proven.
Every remaining fallback/sentinel match is classified as current effect infrastructure, unrelated host behavior, or an explicitly D08-owned numeric item.
